title.narrative: Consultancy support to CSOs core support assistance (II)
Consultancy support to CSOs core support assistance (II)

description.narrative:
Sveriges ambassad i Chisinau har ett omfattande kärnstödsprogram för moldaviska enskilda organisationer (EO/NGOs) i syfte att stärka och utveckla deras interna kapacitet. Ambassaden arbetar inte på projektbasis med dessa EO, utan enbart via kärnstödsprogrammet. De EO ambassaden arbetar med är aktiva inom de områden som faller inom strategin för Sveriges reformsamarbete med Östeuropa, västra Balkan och Turkiet 2014–2020.
I syfte att ge både ett transparent och professionellt stöd till arbetet med EO, upphandlade ambassaden konsulttjänster via ett öppet upphandlingsförfarande. Swedish Development Advisers (SDA) valdes för att genomföra uppdraget under 2019–2021. Den totala budgeten för projektet är 2 886 601 SEK.
I enighet med ToR, ska konsulten granska, ge rekommendationer och stödja genomförandet av bland andra de EO som genomgår den första fasen av kärnstödsprogrammet (pre-core phase). Detta program genomförs bland annat genom utbildningar för kärnstödspartners. Konsulten kommer också att hjälpa ambassaden med uppföljning av den organisatoriska utvecklingen, före, under och efter kärnstödsprogrammet.

The Embassy of Sweden in Chisinau supports a comprehensive core support programme for Moldovan CSO:s to develop their internal capacities to manage positive results in their strategic work and to support positive reforms to ensure a better life for all citizens in Moldova. The Embassy is not working with project-type support to CSO:s. Core support is the only tool used to work directly with local CSO:s. The selected organizations are active involved in the intervention areas supported by Sweden in Moldova within the Result Strategy for Sweden’s reform cooperation with Eastern Europe, the Western Balkans and Turkey 2014-2020.
In order to provide professional assistance in institutional development, the Embassy procured consultancy services through an open procurement procedure. Swedish Development Advisors (SDA) was selected to implement the assignment in 2019-2021. The total budget for the intervention is 2 886 601 SEK.
According to the ToR, the contractor is supposed to be involved in conducting system-based audits, in providing recommendations and support of implementing these recommendations during the pre-core phase, in providing support to ongoing core support partners through trainings etc. The contractor will also assist the Embassy in follow-up on the organizational development during the pre-core and core support period.

Training of CSOs:
Training for Generation II CSOs: Communication and Visibility course (Nov, 2019) Monitoring and Evaluation course (Nov, 2019) Sub-granting course (Dec, 2019) Trust-based management approach to leadership for Generation II. (Mar, 2020) Training for Generation III CSOs: RAF, strategic planning and introduction to RBM training (Sep, 2019) Crosscutting issues (Oct, 2019) Governance, anti-corruption and audit (Oct, 2019) Advocacy and Communication Workshops for the Coalition Life without Domestic Violence and the Transnistrian Platform on domestic violence prevention and womens rights promotion, respectively. Workshops on Strategic communication and development of communication strategies for Artemida, NEC and AJMTEM (Dec, 2020) Virtual Leadership Retreat for Artemida, NEC and AJMTEM Sub-granting training for Artemida and NEC. Trainings for Generation IV Results Assessment Framework (RAF), strategic planning and introduction to Results based management (RBM) for generation IV (Mar, 2021) Governance, Anti-corruption and Audit training for generation IV (Mar, 2021) Generation III Monitoring and evaluation training (Nov, 2021).
Reports on Follow-up of Recommendations from the SBA
Follow-up audits of Generation II CSOs (done Jun-Aug 2019) IDOM, Independent Journalist Center, Resonance, and Womens Law Center (WLC) Follow-up audits of Generation III CSOs (done between Jan and Apr 2020) ADEPT, Artemida, Contact Center, Center for Investigative Journalism (CIJ), VESTA, National Environmental Center, and Follow-up audits of Generation IV CSOs (done between Dec 2021 and Feb 2022) Association of Librarians of the Republic of Moldova (ABRM), Womens Initiative (WI), University Legal Clinic (ULC), Center for Analysis and Prevention of Corruption (CAPC), ONG Biotica, Center for Policy and Reform, and
Coaching of CSOs
Generation I Coaching of Resonance on their new strategic direction (Mar 2020), Support to EEF on establishing a whistleblowing policy and procedure. Generation II The following CSOs were coached: LRCM, Contact Center, Coalition Life without Domestic Violence, WLC, Ecovisio. Generation III Artemida and VESTA, Workshop sessions on HRBA, Gender Analysis and Conflict Sensitivity with NEC, AJTMEM and Artemida. Generation IV Association of Librarians, Womens Initiative, Center for Policy and Reform (CPR), Center for Analysis of Prevention of Corruption (CAPC), University Legal Clinic (ULC), and National Environmental Center (NEC).
Systems-based audits (SBA) of the following CSOs (Aug- Dec 2020)
National Environmental Center (NEC), Association of Librarians of the Republic of Moldova (ABRM), Womens Initiative (WI), University Legal Clinic (ULC), Center for Analysis and Prevention of Corruption (CAPC), ONG Biotica, Center for Policy and Reform (CPR), Platforma, and Music and Choral Association.
Evaluations
Summarized Core Support Evaluation of Moldovan Institute for Human Rights (IDOM) (Dec, 2019), Summarized Core Support Evaluation of Independent Journalism Center (IJC) (Dec, 2019), Summarized Core Support Evaluation of Resonance (Dec, 2019), Summarized Core Support Evaluation of Womens Law Center (WLC) (Dec, 2019), Evaluation of Expert Grup (Nov, 2019), Evaluation of two CSOs platforms working with womens rights in the Republic of Moldova (including in the Transnistrian region) (Dec, 2019), Summative Core Support Evaluation of EcoContact (Apr, 2021), Summative Core Support Evaluation of Ecovisio (Apr, 2021), Evaluation of WLCs Strategic Plan (Dec, 2021), Summarized Core Support Evaluation of Genderdoc-M (Apr, 2022), and Summative Core Support Evaluation of the Legal Resources Centre from Moldova (May, 2022).
Tuesday Dialogues
Tuesday dialogues: seven virtual sessions were held between Nov 2021 and May 2022 for all CSOs.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
